Leaflet 1.9.4
License: BSD-2-Clause. See LICENSE.
Project: https://leafletjs.com/
Source: https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet/tree/v1.9.4
Official distribution: https://registry.npmjs.org/leaflet/-/leaflet-1.9.4.tgz

The JavaScript, source maps, CSS and images are unmodified files from the official
1.9.4 distribution. Human-readable source is included as leaflet-src.js.
No CDN requests are used to load Leaflet. Map tiles are separate online services
documented in the plugin readme.
